value.rationale: The three natural moduli of a uniformly tagged twisted torus are classified with a sharp product limit: Gamma area scale, a universal inverse-square count of first-coordinate cycles, and uniformly distributed twist. This addresses structural observable distributions beyond the known CLT for aggregate orbit count.
